text: Both .landing (line 8) and .landing-band (line 229) use overflow: visible, so neither clips. Change both to hidden; .landing--branded already overrides overflow for scrolling.
command: cd /work/apps/canvas && sed -i '8s/overflow: visible;/overflow: hidden;/;229s/overflow: visible;/overflow: hidden;/' src/styles/landing.css && grep -n 'overflow' src/styles/landing.css
